historyPolicy: presentation-only; excluded from semantic company history and product maturity

chapters.title: See the system before reading the brochure.
chapters.copy: Start with the invisible operating field: agent intent, policy, evidence and execution become something a visitor can inspect.
chapters.proof: Complex capability becomes understandable in motion.

chapters.title: Give agent intent a shape.
chapters.copy: Typed workflows expose tools, memory and orchestration as explicit engineering structure.
chapters.proof: The workflow becomes reviewable before runtime.

chapters.title: Put control before autonomy.
chapters.copy: Risk, policy, approvals, sandbox execution and evidence become visible gates rather than a compliance paragraph.
chapters.proof: Governance becomes an operating path, not a document.

chapters.title: Turn capability into something people understand.
chapters.copy: Presentation changes hierarchy, motion and interaction without changing the underlying product truth.
chapters.proof: Design becomes product explanation, not decoration.

chapters.title: Let curiosity become navigation.
chapters.copy: Questions, experiments and connected paths turn learning content into an explorable world.

chapters.title: Let experiments leave evidence behind.
chapters.copy: Experiments either graduate into reusable primitives or remain visibly experimental.
chapters.proof: The website can show evolution without pretending everything is finished.
